# cosmoner_postgres_database (Resource)

A dedicated PostgreSQL database. **Billed from creation**, to the project's saved card.

`apply` waits until the database is online, up to `timeouts.create` (default 30 minutes). A database that ends in an error, or is still starting at the deadline, is kept in state as tainted, so the next apply replaces it; the provider never deletes it on its own. A create the API refuses (an unavailable size, region or version, or a project that cannot be billed) leaves nothing behind.

The API has no route to change a database, so changing any argument replaces it, **and its data with it**. Consider `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }`.

Needs `databases:read` and `databases:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cosmoner_postgres_database" "main" {
  name    = "main"
  size    = "postgres-cosmoner-1vcpu-1gb"
  version = "17"
  region  = "se-sto"

  # Every argument replaces the database, and its data with it.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Hand the connection string to the apps that use it.
resource "cosmoner_secret" "database_url" {
  name  = "DATABASE_URL"
  value = cosmoner_postgres_database.main.connection_uri
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name: lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens, up to 63 characters. Names are not unique; the API tells databases apart by ID.
- `region` (String) Region slug from the database catalogue. The API refuses a region the size is not sold in.
- `size` (String) Size slug from the database catalogue, e.g. `postgres-cosmoner-1vcpu-1gb`. Changing it replaces the database.
- `version` (String) PostgreSQL major version, e.g. `"17"`.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project the resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `connection_uri` (String, Sensitive) Connection URI for `host`, **including the password**. Readable with `databases:read`.
- `created_at` (String) When the database was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `database` (String) Name of the database created in the cluster.
- `host` (String) Host apps on Cosmoner connect to. Reachable only from inside the platform.
- `id` (String) Database ID.
- `port` (Number) Port to connect on.
- `public_connection_uri` (String, Sensitive) Connection URI for `public_host` with `sslmode=require`, **including the password**. Null where there is no public host.
- `public_host` (String) Host to connect to from outside Cosmoner, on port 5432 with TLS required. Null where there is none.
- `status` (String) `ONLINE` once ready. `CREATING`, `ERROR`, `RESIZING` and `MIGRATING` are the other states the API reports.
- `username` (String) User to connect as.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the database to come online. Defaults to `30m`.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for the database to be deleted. Defaults to `15m`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<database_id>, or just <database_id> when the provider sets a project.
terraform import cosmoner_postgres_database.main proj_123/clx0database
```
